authority_boundary.statement: Derived learner-loop evidence only; this file does not create learner state, mastery probabilities, curriculum authority or canonical questions.
authority_boundary.assisted_evidence: DEMONSTRATED with HINT, WORKED_EXAMPLE or SOLUTION remains effectively UNCERTAIN for routing until independent verification.
authority_boundary.ambiguity: Multi-capability failure is not attributed until diagnosis distinguishes the failed capability.
authority_boundary.repair: Use the narrowest existing canonical teaching step or misconception repair, followed by a fresh verification item when available.
authority_boundary.transfer: Matrix transfer rows are authoring specifications for changed demand; they are not learner-executable Core2B questions by themselves.

missing_executable_core2b_for_existing_c.changed_demand: A spherical source is shown with the receiver outside it, but the problem labels altitude above the surface instead of centre distance.
missing_executable_core2b_for_existing_c.information_not_handed_over: that the simple external Newtonian relation requires centre-to-centre r rather than altitude alone

missing_executable_core2b_for_existing_c.changed_demand: A projectile is moving upward near the same source: determine the gravitational-force direction without using its velocity direction.
missing_executable_core2b_for_existing_c.information_not_handed_over: that gravity direction follows source-receiver geometry and persists during upward motion

missing_executable_core2b_for_existing_c.changed_demand: Two different test masses are placed at the same point; compare local g and gravitational force before either is released.
missing_executable_core2b_for_existing_c.information_not_handed_over: that local g is source/location dependent while force additionally scales with the chosen test mass

missing_executable_core2b_for_existing_c.changed_demand: The same object has half the weight at a second location; infer the local-g ratio without changing the object's mass.
missing_executable_core2b_for_existing_c.information_not_handed_over: that W = m g permits solving for the g ratio while mass stays fixed

missing_executable_core2b_for_existing_c.changed_demand: A rough track replaces a frictionless one and the learner must decide whether simple mechanical-energy conservation still applies.
A force-and-path diagram must be translated into signed work contributions before an energy balance can be written.
missing_executable_core2b_for_existing_c.information_not_handed_over: which force components are along the actual displacement

missing_executable_core2b_for_existing_c.changed_demand: A moving support does work through its contact force, so the learner must include that external transfer before solving for the final kinetic energy.
missing_executable_core2b_for_existing_c.information_not_handed_over: whether the contact point itself moves along the force direction

missing_executable_core2b_for_existing_c.changed_demand: Two machines perform the same task with different time profiles and the learner must separate total work from average and instantaneous power.
missing_executable_core2b_for_existing_c.information_not_handed_over: which reported rate is tied to the whole interval rather than a single instant

missing_executable_core2b_for_existing_c.changed_demand: A numerical energy problem includes friction and the learner must decide whether to use mechanical-energy conservation alone or include an explicit transfer term.
missing_executable_core2b_for_existing_c.information_not_handed_over: whether the chosen K + U account is closed

missing_executable_core2b_for_existing_c.changed_demand: Instead of being given K = 0.5 m v^2 or Delta U_g = m g h, the learner must reconstruct each expression from previously authored work, force and motion relations.
missing_executable_core2b_for_existing_c.information_not_handed_over: which already-owned mechanics relations must be chained to derive the two energy expressions

missing_executable_core2b_for_existing_c.changed_demand: A compression/rarefaction description must be translated into local particle motion and propagation direction without drawing particles travelling with the wave.
missing_executable_core2b_for_existing_c.information_not_handed_over: which motion belongs to particles and which belongs to the disturbance

missing_executable_core2b_for_existing_c.changed_demand: Frequency, amplitude and wavelength are all changed in a comparison, requiring separate pitch, loudness and speed reasoning rather than one 'bigger wave' judgment.
missing_executable_core2b_for_existing_c.information_not_handed_over: which physical quantity controls each percept/propagation relation

missing_executable_core2b_for_existing_c.changed_demand: A cave-mapping or animal echolocation problem must be recognized as an ordinary reflected-sound round-trip timing problem.
missing_executable_core2b_for_existing_c.information_not_handed_over: that the measured delay contains both outward and return paths

missing_executable_core2b_for_existing_c.changed_demand: A sampled sound graph must be identified as spatial or temporal before the learner can decide whether horizontal repeat spacing means wavelength or period.
missing_executable_core2b_for_existing_c.information_not_handed_over: whether the horizontal axis is position or time

missing_executable_core2b_for_existing_c.changed_demand: A frequency just outside the approximate human audible band must be classified using the Grade 9 hearing-range model without treating 20 Hz and 20,000 Hz as exact personal hearing thresholds.
missing_executable_core2b_for_existing_c.information_not_handed_over: that the quoted audible band is an approximate usual human-hearing model rather than a universal biological cutoff

missing_executable_core2b_for_existing_c.changed_demand: An unfamiliar workshop tool must be analysed as a generic effort/load machine without being named as a lever, pulley or incline.
A fixed pulley changes force direction but not magnitude, requiring the learner to reject the assumption that all useful machines have MA > 1.
A force advantage is given and the learner must infer the compensating distance tradeoff before calculating or claiming an energy gain.
missing_executable_core2b_for_existing_c.information_not_handed_over: which input/output distances complete the work ledger

decision.reason: Remaining blockers are canonical question inventory while EP-TA-005 prohibits Physics academic edits.
decision.successor_scope: Separately bounded academic authoring: exactly 7 missing direct Core2A practice items plus 18 Core2B items from existing core transfer specifications, followed by the six-matrix learner-loop proof.
